tweets.text:
Here are all the most important highlights from @SpaceX's Q3 2026 earnings report and earnings call:

• Total revenue: $14.58B, up 161% YoY from $5.58B and up 87% QoQ from $7.81B.

• Adjusted EBITDA: $8.81B, up 306% YoY from $2.17B and up 149% QoQ from $3.54B.

• Total Capex: $19.59B, up 185% YoY from $6.88B and 7% QoQ from $18.37B, primarily driven by SI infrastructure investments.

• Q4 Capex guidance: SpaceX expects capital expenditures of $35B–$40B in Q4 2026 as it accelerates SI compute deployment.

• Net income: $4.40B, compared to a $1.05B loss a year earlier.

• Income from operations: $2.79B, compared to a $273M loss YoY and a $143M loss in Q2.

• Q1 2027 revenue guidance: $33B–$37B in total revenue during Q1 2027.

• Annualized revenue target: SpaceX remains on track for $100B in annualized revenue by the end of 2026, based on December's revenue run rate.

• Elon's 2027 revenue projection: SpaceX could reach $500B–$1T in annual recurring revenue by the end of 2027

• Backlog: Reached $63B as of September 30, including $17.5B in deferred revenue. ~$42B is expected to be recognized within the next 12 months.

• Space revenue: $1.77B, up 6% YoY

• Connectivity revenue: $5.25B, up 69% YoY and 22% QoQ; Consumer revenue was $3.12B (+57% YoY) and Enterprise & Government revenue was $2.13B (+91% YoY).

• Connectivity operating income: $2.37B, up 99% YoY from $1.19B and 43% QoQ from $1.66B.

• Starlink subscribers: 13.6M, up 89% YoY; consumer ARPU increased to $69/month from $66 in Q2.

• Super Intelligence (SI) revenue: $7.56B, up 830% YoY and 195% QoQ

• SI operating income: Positive $431M, compared to a $1.72B loss YoY and a $1.26B loss in Q2.

• SI Adjusted EBITDA: Positive $4.95B, compared to a $428M loss a year earlier and $1.15B in Q2.

• SI Capex: $16.44B, up 245% YoY from $4.76B and 4% QoQ from $15.83B, representing ~84% of total quarterly Capex spend.

• Cloud Services Agreements: Signed additional agreements during Q3, with SI solutions and infrastructure revenue growing 192% QoQ excluding Cursor.

• SI compute economics: Newly deployed compute capacity is generating payback periods of less than 12 months at current pricing, which is slightly above the previously discussed $30–$50 per watt range.

• Cursor revenue: Contributed $608M in revenue between August 14 and September 30.

• Grok Bot: Reached 800,000 paid weekly users in early October, more than doubling over the prior month.

• Grok Bot enterprise rollout expected in a few weeks.

• Cash, cash equivalents & marketable securities: Approximately $90B at quarter-end

• Operating cash flow: Generated $13.1B during the first nine months of 2026, up 218% from $4.12B during the same period in 2025.

• Starship Flight 15: Targeted for November 2026, with SpaceX planning to attempt a tower catch of Starship's upper stage.

• National Security launches: Secured 18 additional National Security Space Launch missions.

• Starlink aviation: More than 3,800 aircraft were equipped with Starlink as of September 30.

• Starlink aviation contracts: ~12,000 aircraft are now under contract for Starlink service, representing nearly a quarter of the available commercial aircraft market.

• Starlink Mobile users: Surpassed 22M monthly users at the end of Q3, up 37% QoQ.

• Starlink Mobile U.S. launch: SpaceX plans to integrate its spectrum acquisitions and begin activating the expanded service in early 2028, with the gaol of becoming a major U.S. mobile carrier.

• SI compute: Expanded nameplate compute capacity to 1.7 GW, up from 1.4 GW in Q2 and 0.6 GW a year earlier.

• October compute target: SpaceX expects to reach nearly 2 GW of nameplate compute capacity by the end of October 2026.

• Year-end compute target: SpaceX expects 2.5–3 GW of nameplate compute capacity by the end of 2026.

• 2027 compute target: Elon expects to add at least 10 GW of incremental compute capacity in 2027, potentially bringing the total to 13 GW or more. Elon said there is a small possibility of exceeding 20+ GW of active SI compute by the end of 2027.

• GPU deployments: SpaceX is bringing approximately 200,000–220,000 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs online monthly, with plans to maintain or accelerate that pace.

• Nvidia Vera Rubin deployment: SpaceX expects its 2027 compute expansion to rely primarily on NVIDIA's next-generation Vera Rubin architecture.

• SpaceX plans to bring a training cluster with 440,000 Vera Rubin computers online by the end of Q2 2027.

• Targeting May or June 2027 for the first functional test chips from the Austin research fab.

• Terafab mass production: SpaceX is targeting Q3–Q4 2028 for potential volume chip production at its Gibbons Creek facility
tweets.text_zh:
以下是 @SpaceX 2026 年第三季度收益报告和收益电话会议的所有最重要亮点：

• 总收入：$14.58B，较 $5.58B 同比增长 161%，较 $7.81B 环比增长 87%。

• 调整后 EBITDA：$8.81B，较 $2.17B 同比增长 306%，较 $3.54B 环比增长 149%。

• 总资本支出：$19.59B，较 $6.88B 同比增长 185%，较 $18.37B 环比增长 7%，主要由 SI 基础设施投资推动。

• 第四季度资本支出指引：SpaceX 预计 2026 年第四季度的资本支出为 $35B-$40B，因为它加速了 SI 计算部署。

• 净收入：$4.40B，而去年同期亏损$1.05B。

• 运营收入：$2.79B，相比之下，同比亏损 2.73 亿美元，第二季度亏损 1.43 亿美元。

• 2027 年第一季度收入指导：2027 年第一季度总收入为 $33B–$37B。

• 年化收入目标：根据 12 月的收入运行率，到 2026 年底，SpaceX 仍有望实现年化收入 100B 美元。

• Elon 的 2027 年收入预测：到 2027 年底，SpaceX 的年度经常性收入可能达到 $500B–$1T

• 积压订单：截至 9 月 30 日已达到 $63B，其中包括 $17.5B 递延收入。 ~$42B 预计将在未来 12 个月内得到认可。

• 空间收入：$1.77B，同比增长 6%

• 连接收入：$5.25B，同比增长 69%，环比增长 22%；消费者收入为 $3.12B（同比增长 57%），企业和政府收入为 $2.13B（同比增长 91%）。

• 连接运营收入：$2.37B，比 $1.19B 同比增长 99%，比上一季度比 $1.66B 增长 43%。

• Starlink 用户：1,360 万，同比增长 89%；消费者 ARPU 从第二季度的 66 美元增加到每月 69 美元。

• 超级智能（SI）收入：$7.56B，同比增长 830%，环比增长 195%

• SI 营业收入：正 4.31 亿美元，而同比亏损 1.72B 美元，第二季度亏损 1.26B 美元。

• SI 调整后 EBITDA：正 $4.95B，而去年同期亏损 $428M，第二季度亏损 $1.15B。

• SI 资本支出：$16.44B，较 $4.76B 同比增长 245%，较 $15.83B 环比增长 4%，约占季度资本支出总额的 84%。

• 云服务协议：第三季度签署了额外协议，SI 解决方案和基础设施收入环比增长 192%（不包括 Cursor）。

• SI 计算经济性：按当前定价，新部署的计算容量的投资回收期不到 12 个月，略高于之前讨论的每瓦 30 至 50 美元范围。

• Cursor 收入：8 月 14 日至 9 月 30 日期间贡献了 6.08 亿美元的收入。

• Grok Bot：10 月初达到 800,000 名每周付费用户，比上个月增加了一倍多。

• Grok Bot 预计将在几周内推出企业版。

• 现金、现金等价物和有价证券：季度末约为 $90B

• 运营现金流：2026 年前 9 个月产生 $13.1B，比 2025 年同期的 $4.12B 增长 218%。

• Starship Flight 15：计划于 2026 年 11 月进行，SpaceX 计划尝试用塔式捕获 Starship 的上级。

• 国家安全发射：完成 18 次额外的国家安全太空发射任务。

• 星链航空：截至 9 月 30 日，已有 3,800 多架飞机配备了星链。

• Starlink 航空合同：目前约有 12,000 架飞机签订了 Starlink 服务合同，占可用商用飞机市场的近四分之一。

• Starlink Mobile 用户：第三季度末月用户数突破 2200 万，环比增长 37%。

• Starlink Mobile 在美国推出：SpaceX 计划整合其频谱收购，并于 2028 年初开始启动扩展服务，目标是成为美国主要移动运营商。

• SI 计算：将铭牌计算容量扩大至 1.7 GW，高于第二季度的 1.4 GW 和一年前的 0.6 GW。

• 10 月计算目标：SpaceX 预计到 2026 年 10 月底达到近 2 GW 的铭牌计算容量。

• 年终计算目标：SpaceX 预计到 2026 年底，铭牌计算容量将达到 2.5–3 GW。
• 2027 年计算目标：Elon 预计在 2027 年增加至少 10 GW 的增量计算容量，可能使总数达到 13 GW 或更多。 Elon 表示，到 2027 年底，活跃 SI 计算量超过 20 GW 的可能性很小。

• GPU 部署：SpaceX 每月在线提供约 200,000-220,000 个 NVIDIA GB300 GPU，并计划保持或加快这一速度。

• Nvidia Vera Rubin 部署：SpaceX 预计其 2027 年的计算扩展将主要依赖 NVIDIA 的下一代 Vera Rubin 架构。

• SpaceX 计划在 2027 年第二季度末将包含 440,000 台 Vera Rubin 计算机的训练集群上线。

• 目标是在 2027 年 5 月或 6 月从奥斯汀研究工厂生产第一批功能测试芯片。

• Terafab 量产：SpaceX 的目标是 2028 年第三季度至第四季度在其 Gibbons Creek 工厂实现潜在的芯片量产

“由于将资源分配和消费混为一谈，对经济学产生了根本性的误解；我已经创造了。我所谓的财富只是 SpaceX 和 Tesla 的百分比所有权。这将被征收相当高的税，而且没有什么神奇的方法可以避税。如果有的话我会知道的。最终，这将被削弱，几代人后，如果金钱仍然重要，但我认为不会，我的后代将只拥有一小部分我所拥有的。”

tweets.text:
Happy SpaceX Q3 earnings day! Wall Street is expecting this to be SpaceX's first profitable quarter on an adjusted basis since going public in June ($0.13/share).

Here are the most voted for questions by retail investors for today's earnings call:

1) Gwynne Shotwell told us Starship HLS hardware is now being produced in Starbase, how much progress has been made so far and when will the test article be shown off?

2) When will SpaceX merge with Tesla?

3) When does SpaceX intend on performing the orbital refueling demo for Starship? and will it be a comination with the long duration demo?

4) Can you provide a detailed update on the Starbase Louisiana project timeline, including the current status of coastal-use and environmental permitting for the supporting infrastructure in Vermilion Parish, whether the March 2027 construction start target remains on track, and SpaceX’s current confidence level in achieving a first Starship launch from the site as early as 2029?

5) Does SpaceX plan to make a larger Starship payload door for non flat-packed satellites in the near future? If so, what is the timeline and current progress?

6) With Artemis 3 in less than a year, a lunar landing demo targeting in Q4 2027 and Artemis 4 lunar landing in roughly 18 months, what progress have you made on HLS and can we see pictures.

The full cabin mockup has been in work for a year in the starfactory and we haven't seen any pictures of it. Do you have an update on it or even pictures?

It's been about a year since your last HLS update and it will be about a year until the uncrewed demo, could we see some progress?

7) What have you learned from the Ship that landed intact that will help future missions?
tweets.text_zh:
SpaceX 第三季度财报日快乐！华尔街预计，这将是 SpaceX 自 6 月份上市（每股 0.13 美元）以来调整后第一个实现盈利的季度。

以下是今天的财报电话会议中散户投资者投票最多的问题：

1) Gwynne Shotwell 告诉我们 Starship HLS 硬件现在正在 Starbase 生产，到目前为止取得了多少进展，测试品什么时候展示？

2）SpaceX什么时候会与特斯拉合并？

3）SpaceX打算什么时候为Starship进行轨道加油演示？它会与长时间演示相结合吗？

4) 您能否提供路易斯安那州 Starbase 项目时间表的详细更新信息，包括 Vermilion Parish 配套基础设施的沿海使用和环境许可现状、2027 年 3 月开工目标是否仍按计划进行，以及 SpaceX 目前对最早在 2029 年从该地点实现首次 Starship 发射的信心水平？

5) SpaceX 是否计划在不久的将来为非扁平包装卫星制造更大的 Starship 有效载荷门？如果有，时间表和目前进展如何？

完整的客舱模型已经在星际工厂工作了一年，但我们还没有看到它的任何照片。你有更新吗？甚至有图片吗？

距离上次 HLS 更新已经过去了大约一年，距离无人演示也大约有一年了，我们能看到一些进展吗？

7) 您从完好着陆的飞船中学到了什么有助于未来的任务？

tweets.text:
This is the larger 400-liter carbon overwrapped pressure vessel (COPV) that will go in the passenger seat in the rocket trim of @Tesla's Roadster, which is why this version is a one-seater. Combined with a 200L tank in the rear, available only on the Thrust and Rocket trims, the Rocket trim will have a total capacity of 600L.

Rocket trim comes with 10 total thrusters around the vehicle: Four rear-facing, four downward-facing, and two side-facing.

• Performance trim: Four rear fans, suction system and front and rear deployable skirts.
• Thrust trim: Four rear fans, suction system, front and rear deployable skirts & four rear-facing acceleration thrusters (with 200L COPV tank).
• Rocket trim: Four rear fans, suction system, front and rear deployable skirts, four rear-facing acceleration thrusters (with 200L COPV tank), four-downward facing & two side facing thrusters (with 400L COPV tank).










Sawyer Merritt (@SawyerMerritt)

Here is the next-gen Tesla Roadster development video from the unveil event that they shared exclusively with us.

Video

tweets.text_zh:
这是更大的 400 升碳包裹压力容器 (COPV)，将安装在 @Tesla Roadster 火箭装饰的乘客座椅上，这就是为什么这个版本是单座的。加上后部的 200 升油箱（仅适用于 Thrust 和 Rocket 车型），Rocket 车型的总容量将达到 600 升。

火箭装饰在车辆周围总共有 10 个推进器：四个朝后、四个朝下和两个侧面。

• 性能装饰：四个后风扇、抽吸系统以及前后可展开裙板。
• 推力装饰：四个后风扇、抽吸系统、前后可展开裙板和四个后向加速推进器（带200L COPV 油箱）。
• 火箭装饰：四个后风扇、吸气系统、前后可展开裙板、四个后向加速推进器（带 200L COPV 油箱）、四个朝下和两个侧面推进器（带 400L COPV 油箱）。

tweets.text:
Ark Invest on a potenial Tesla-SpaceX merger:

 "A SpaceX-Tesla merger could take place within the next five years. Tesla’s highly cash-generative robotaxi network could help fund SpaceX’s ambitious plans for orbital data centers, and at the same time SpaceX’s compute-intensive frontier AI models could serve as the planning layer for Optimus deployments. Working together on the Terafab project, both companies could alleviate chip constraints. Combined, we estimate that SpaceX and Tesla could generate $3.8 trillion in revenue and $2.7 trillion in EBIT15 by 2031, with SpaceX contributing roughly 62% and 69%, respectively."




Sawyer Merritt (@SawyerMerritt)

ARK Invest has just released their new Tesla valuation model, projecting @Tesla could reach a $17.5 trillion valuation by 2031, and upwards of $20.4 trillion in a bull case.

ARK's 2031 Tesla base case: $4,400/share
• ~1M Optimus robots sold externally, generating ~$212B in revenue
• Robotaxi is ~80% of Tesla's enterprise value (down from ~90% in ARK's 2029 model)
• ~8.1M robotaxis deployed, with ~$753B in ride-hail revenue
• Total revenue of ~$1.45T and EBITDA of ~$902B
• Market cap of ~$17.5T
• Tesla's AI infrastructure spend grows from ~$7B to $225B cumulatively

ARK's 2031 Tesla bull case: $5,000/share
• EV revenue (excluding credits): $355B
• Robotaxis: 10M vehicles and $899B in ride-hail revenue
• Energy storage: 2,693 GWh deployed and $193B in revenue
• Optimus: 1.2M robots sold externally and $254B in revenue
• Total revenue: $1.62T
• EBITDA: $1.045T, a 65% margin, with a 72% gross margin
• Market cap: $20.4T

ARK's model does not assume SpaceX and Tesla merge, but they estimate combined SpaceX and Tesla could generate $3.8T in revenue by 2031, with SpaceX contributing ~62%.







— http://nitter.meowing.monster/SawyerMerritt/status/2112302499696636149#m

Ark Invest 对特斯拉与 SpaceX 潜在合并的看法：

 “SpaceX 与特斯拉的合并可能会在未来五年内发生。特斯拉的高度现金生成的机器人出租车网络可以为 SpaceX 雄心勃勃的轨道数据中心计划提供资金，同时 SpaceX 的计算密集型前沿人工智能模型可以作为 Optimus 部署的规划层。两家公司在 Terafab 项目上的合作可以缓解芯片限制。我们估计 SpaceX 和特斯拉合计可以产生 3.8 万亿美元的收入和 2.7 万亿美元的收入到 2031 年，息税前利润为 15%，其中 SpaceX 分别贡献约 62% 和 69%。”




索耶·梅里特（@SawyerMerritt）

ARK 的 2031 年特斯拉基本情况：4,400 美元/股
• 约 100 万个 Optimus 机器人对外销售，产生约 212B 美元的收入
• Robotaxi 约占 Tesla 企业价值的 80%（低于 ARK 2029 年车型的约 90%）
• 部署了约 810 万辆机器人出租车，网约车收入约 753B 美元
• 总收入约为 $1.45T，EBITDA 约为 $902B
• 市值约为 17.5T 美元
• 特斯拉的人工智能基础设施支出累计从约 $7B 增长至 $225B

ARK 的 2031 年特斯拉牛市案例：5,000 美元/股
• 电动汽车收入（不包括积分）：$355B
• 机器人出租车：1000 万辆汽车和 899B 美元的网约车收入
• 能源存储：部署 2,693 GWh，收入 193B 美元
• Optimus：对外销售 120 万台机器人，收入达 254B 美元
• 总收入：$1.62T
• EBITDA：1.045T 美元，利润率为 65%，毛利率为 72%
• 市值：$20.4T

ARK 的模型并未假设 SpaceX 和特斯拉合并，但他们估计 SpaceX 和特斯拉合并后可在 2031 年产生 3.8T 美元的收入，其中 SpaceX 贡献约 62%。

tweets.text:
Tesla has officially announced that it will hold its annual shareholder meeting on December 3, 2026. There are three items up for a vote:

• Re-electing Elon Musk, Robyn Denholm and JB Straubel to the board for three-year terms.
• A non-binding say-on-pay vote on 2025 executive compensation. The compensation table lists about $158.4 billion in 2025 stock awards for Musk.
• Approving PWC as Tesla's auditor for 2026.

There is no mention of any merger with SpaceX in this proxy filing. Letter from Tesla Chair of the Board, Robyn Denholm:

"Dear Fellow Shareholders,
2026 has been a year of investment and progress for Tesla. We continued solidifying our foundation by strengthening our core vehicle, energy and services businesses as we build the infrastructure for our next phase of growth. 

We also moved closer to a future of autonomous transportation and real-world super intelligence (“SI”). This year, we began producing Cybercab at Gigafactory Texas and expanded our Robotaxi service to more U.S. cities. FSD (Supervised) usage grew exponentially as we continued to gain users and expand into new markets. We surpassed over 10 million vehicles delivered, and the Model Y remains on track to be the best-selling vehicle this year of any kind, globally, as we achieved record deliveries in countries around the world. We launched the Tesla Semi, which will revolutionize the trucking industry, and unveiled the long- awaited Next Gen Roadster. We also made progress in energy generation and storage, with record deployments out of Megafactory Shanghai and production of the new Megapack 3 at our Megafactory in Texas. As SI infrastructure demand increases, energy storage will be critical to expand capacity from the existing grid.

At the same time, we continued developing the products and investing in the infrastructure required to provide them at scale, including building our Semi factory in Nevada and the first production lines for Optimus, and additional data center capacity to train our SI systems. Our recent investments in battery and  chip manufacturing, including our Terafab initiative, will help secure the supply of critical components enabling us to offer products affordably on a mass market basis so that humanity may benefit. We remain focused on managing costs and maintaining the financial strength to support our ambitious long-term goals. 

We have accomplished a great deal, but we are still at the early stages of what we believe Tesla can become. Our employees’ innovation, hard work and dedication are essential to realizing that potential and creating lasting value for you, our shareholders. Your confidence in Tesla means a great deal to us, and we take the trust of our shareholders seriously. We listen to you, as your voices and votes help shape our governance and our future. And, as a Board, we want to continue hearing from as many of you as possible. 

That includes retail investors, who face technological barriers to traditional voting. As a result, Tesla recently pioneered the creation of user-friendly practical tools to empower the voices of retail shareholders, which provide a no-fee, investor-directed voting process similar to those currently available to institutional investors. And because we believe all retail voices should be heard across the capital markets, we have made sure the framework supporting enrollment into voluntary retail voting programs would not only be available to Tesla, but to all public companies. As we look ahead, we have the building blocks, vision and team necessary to achieve our bold yet worthwhile objectives. I am honored to serve on the Board alongside Elon Musk and JB Straubel, two technological visionaries whose leadership has helped make Tesla what it is today. The three of us are grateful to have been nominated to serve for another term on the Board of this extraordinary company. We understand that a steady and experienced hand during this time of rapid technological change is essential to Tesla’s success. Therefore, your vote is critical to maintaining that leadership, and I ask you to vote FOR our re-election to the Board so we can continue guiding Tesla through our next phase of growth. 

We have transformed numerous industries before, ranging from electric vehicles to battery storage systems. We could not be more excited to do it again, as we bring SI into the physical world. The best is yet to come.

Thank you for your continued support of Tesla. Very truly yours,
Robyn Denholm
Chair of the Board"
tweets.text_zh:
特斯拉正式宣布将于2026年12月3日召开年度股东大会，表决事项包括三项：

• 再次选举 Elon Musk、Robyn Denholm 和 JB Straubel 为董事会成员，任期三年。
• 对 2025 年高管薪酬进行不具约束力的薪酬发言权投票。薪酬表列出了马斯克2025年约1584亿美元的股票奖励。
• 批准普华永道担任特斯拉 2026 年审计师。

这份代理文件中没有提及与 SpaceX 的任何合并。特斯拉董事会主席 Robyn Denholm 致信：

“尊敬的各位股东，
2026年对于特斯拉来说是投资和进步的一年。我们通过加强核心汽车、能源和服务业务，继续巩固我们的基础，为下一阶段的增长奠定基础。 

我们还距离自动交通和现实世界超级智能（“SI”）的未来更近了。今年，我们开始在德克萨斯州 Gigafactory 生产 Cybercab，并将我们的 Robotaxi 服务扩展到更多美国城市。随着我们不断获得用户并拓展新市场，FSD（受监督）的使用量呈指数级增长。我们的交付量已超过 1000 万辆，而且 Model Y 仍有望成为今年全球最畅销的车型，因为我们在世界各国的交付量都创下了纪录。我们推出了 Tesla Semi，它将彻底改变卡车运输行业，并推出了期待已久的下一代 Roadster。我们在能源生产和存储方面也取得了进展，上海 Megafactory 的部署创纪录，并在德克萨斯州的 Megafactory 生产了新的 Megapack 3。随着SI基础设施需求的增加，储能对于扩大现有电网的容量至关重要。

与此同时，我们继续开发产品并投资大规模提供这些产品所需的基础设施，包括在内华达州建设我们的 Semi 工厂和 Optimus 的第一条生产线，以及用于培训我们的 SI 系统的额外数据中心容量。我们最近在电池和芯片制造方面的投资，包括我们的 Terafab 计划，将有助于确保关键组件的供应，使我们能够在大众市场上提供价格实惠的产品，从而使人类受益。我们仍然专注于管理成本和保持财务实力，以支持我们雄心勃勃的长期目标。 

我们已经取得了很大的成就，但我们仍处于我们相信特斯拉能够成为的早期阶段。我们员工的创新、勤奋和奉献对于实现这一潜力并为您（我们的股东）创造持久价值至关重要。您对特斯拉的信任对我们来说意义重大，我们非常重视股东的信任。我们倾听您的声音，因为您的声音和投票有助于塑造我们的治理和未来。而且，作为董事会，我们希望继续听取尽可能多的人的意见。
其中包括散户投资者，他们在传统投票方面面临技术障碍。因此，特斯拉最近率先创建了用户友好的实用工具，以赋予散户股东发声的权利，这些工具提供了类似于目前机构投资者可以使用的免费、投资者导向的投票流程。因为我们相信资本市场上应该听到所有散户的声音，所以我们确保支持自愿散户投票计划的框架不仅适用于特斯拉，也适用于所有上市公司。展望未来，我们拥有实现我们大胆而有价值的目标所需的基石、愿景和团队。我很荣幸能与埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 和 JB Straubel 一起在董事会任职，这两位技术梦想家的领导帮助特斯拉取得了今天的成就。我们三人很高兴被提名在这家非凡公司的董事会任职连任。我们知道，在这个技术日新月异的时代，稳定且经验丰富的人才对于特斯拉的成功至关重要。因此，您的投票对于维持这种领导地位至关重要，我请您投票支持我们连任董事会成员，以便我们能够继续引导特斯拉进入下一阶段的增长。 

我们之前已经改造了许多行业，从电动汽车到电池存储系统。当我们将 SI 带入物理世界时，我们非常高兴能再次做到这一点。最好的尚未到来。

感谢您一直以来对特斯拉的支持。非常真实的你，
罗宾·丹霍姆
董事会主席”
